MuteBypassSwitch.description: Pass-through switch: hands the upstream value to the downstream node unchanged. Both inputs are optional and accept any type, so muting the upstream node never raises a missing-input error here. When the main link disappears the bypass link takes over, which avoids 'Required input is missing' downstream.

switch.name: Enable bypass
switch.tooltip: On: fall back to the bypass link when main is missing. Off: main only (the bypass link is ignored).

route.name: Route
route.tooltip: auto = prefer main, fall back to bypass when main is missing | main = main only | bypass = bypass only (for debugging).

main.name: Main
main.tooltip: Main link: the one whose upstream node may get muted.

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.tooltip: Bypass link: takes over when main is muted (usually wired straight to the upstream source).

0.name: data
0.tooltip: The exact same object that came in, passed through unchanged.

AnyABSwitch.description: Arbitrary-type A/B selector: outputs whatever the selected link carries, unchanged. If the selected link is not connected it falls back to the other link instead of breaking the downstream node.

which.name: Select
which.tooltip: A outputs link a, B outputs link b.

0.name: data
0.tooltip: The selected link, passed through unchanged.

MultiAnySwitch.description: Multi-input merge: connect any number of links of any type and output the one that carries a value, unchanged. Muted/disabled upstreams are skipped instead of raising an error. A new empty input slot appears as soon as the last one is connected, so you can keep adding links. Want a fixed slot? Set force to 3 to always use slot 3.

switch.name: Enable merge
switch.tooltip: On: pick the first (or last) link that carries a value. Off: only slot 1 is used, as if this node were not there.

pick.name: Pick
pick.tooltip: Which link wins when several carry a value: first = topmost | last = bottommost.

force.name: Force slot
force.tooltip: Force one slot: 0 = auto (pick the link with a value); 1-16 = only that slot, output empty when it has no value (no automatic fallback).

input_1.name: Input 1
input_1.tooltip: Slot 1. Connecting it adds another input slot automatically; keep adding as many as you need.

input_2.name: Input 2
input_2.tooltip: Slot 2. Used when slot 1 is muted.

0.name: data
0.tooltip: The selected link, passed through unchanged.

MultiChannelSwitch.description: Multi-channel merge: each channel has its own candidate links and outputs the one that carries a value, unchanged. Muting an upstream only affects that channel, which falls back on its own; every other channel is untouched. Channels grow automatically: when one is full, the next channel's 2 inputs and 1 output appear (up to 8 channels). Each channel has its own ch{k}_force dropdown (auto/a/b/c), or use the global force to set them all at once.

switch.name: Enable merge
switch.tooltip: On: each channel picks the link that carries a value. Off: each channel uses input a only.

pick.name: Pick
pick.tooltip: Which candidate wins inside a channel when several carry a value: first = topmost | last = bottommost.

force.name: Global force
force.tooltip: Global force: a/b/c = every channel uses only that input; auto = each channel follows its own ch{k}_force.

ch1_a.name: Channel 1 - A
ch1_a.tooltip: Channel 1 main input (wire the branch that may get muted). Filling this channel adds channel 2 automatically.

ch1_b.name: Channel 1 - B
ch1_b.tooltip: Channel 1 fallback input (takes over when main is missing). Filling this channel adds channel 2 automatically.

ch1_force.name: Channel 1 force
ch1_force.tooltip: Channel 1 routing: auto = follow the global force or pick automatically; a, b, c = only that input, output empty when it has no value.

OutputFanoutSwitch.description: One input to N outputs. Connecting input 1 creates out_1..out_n (n = outputs per input); connecting input 2 adds n more, paired with input 2. Every output has an on/off switch. Up to 8 inputs; output slots grow automatically as inputs are connected.

outputs_per_input.tooltip: How many outputs one input gets: 2 means A drives out_1/out_2, B drives out_3/out_4, ...
